title: Lightly Poached Chinese Tofu Mapo Tofu
description: A savory and comforting Chinese dish featuring poached tofu in a spicy sauce, made with semi-skimmed milk for a low-fat friendly option.

ingredients.name: firm tofu
ingredients.notes: drained and cut into small cubes

instructions: In a small bowl, whisk together the cornstarch and a splash of the semi-skimmed milk until smooth.
In a large pot, combine the remaining semi-skimmed milk, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and toasted sichuan peppercorns, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the ground pork to the pot and cook, breaking it up with a spoon, until no longer pink, about 5 minutes.
Add the grated ginger and minced garlic to the pot and cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the cornstarch mixture and cook for 1 minute, until the sauce has thickened.
Add the cubed tofu to the pot and poach for 5 minutes, until lightly cooked through.
Stir in the red pepper flakes and cook for 1 minute.
Transfer the mapo tofu to a bamboo tray and garnish with chopped scallions.
Serve immediately, over steamed rice or noodles if desired.
